tagline: Use sourced public data to solve one founder or investor need.
introduction: Build a focused founder/investor workflow where Cala data is central. Resolve entity ambiguity, source freshness and relevant connections; do not infer a definitive conflict from a single competitor investment or fabricate a completed outreach action.
welcome: What would you like to understand or plan with Cala? Choose a starter below, or share a small redacted example.

capabilities.title: Frame a structured data question
capabilities.description: Translate a research goal into fields, scope and freshness requirements.

capabilities.title: Review provenance
capabilities.description: Review exact field-value, source-digest and source/observation-time bindings in supplied data without treating a citation as truth.
inputs: fictional or redacted sample record with supplied artifacts and timestamps
outputs: field-level consistency, provenance gaps and freshness report; not source authentication

capabilities.title: Plan a verifiable query
capabilities.description: Describe a query and validation path without executing a service call.

capabilities.title: Design Cala challenge support
capabilities.description: Entity and freshness auditor. Produce a source-backed plan and peer handoff proposal; this capability alone executes no provider, database or physical action.
inputs: a scoped public or synthetic task and the exact challenge or integration question
outputs: Coverage and identity-conflict accuracy on labelled founder-investor pairs
source references, dependencies and explicitly unverified actions

starterPrompts: Plan a source-backed entity and freshness auditor task for this challenge.

Prepare a bounded peer-agent handoff with input evidence, expected output, source revision and explicit unknowns.
